source.value: Rippers Unmasked — The Low Fantasy Atlas (Nocebo Weapon)

summary.value: You make a weapon appear as if it were imbued with soul energy.

system.description: You make a weapon appear as if it were imbued with soul energy. Choose a damage type: light or dark. Until this spell ends, all damage dealt by the weapon is of this type. If you have that weapon equipped while casting this spell, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action. This spell can only be cast on a weapon equipped by a willing creature.
